Upstre"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"am dsh is a developer preview: each shell pins one tag, and `patches/<dsh-tag>/` moves with it."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"One process, one origin on the device: the Electron main process **hosts the dsh Host** (webserver +"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" API + WebSocket) and the window loads the standard dsh Web UI from it — no CORS, no auth, no custom"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" protocol, no IPC carrier."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Three HarmonyOS adaptations make it work: **loopback isolation** (bind a wildcard address, then rewr"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ite `Host`/`Origin` back to loopback inside the session), **no symlinks or hardlinks** (copy for pro"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"file publishing, same-directory `rename` for atomic writes), and **`HOME` redirection** into the san"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"dbox. Because the listener is wildcard, treat this as a single-user local app and keep it off untrus"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ted networks.
